  • Inuit↗historical and present
    Connection & source
    historical and present

    Inuit Regions of Canada explicitly locates Nunavik in the selected province/territory. Only this direct region association is used, not its old population/economic forecasts.

    Inuit Nunangat regional association; page contains dated statistics not adopted. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Mohawk↗Present specific constituent community location
    Connection & source
    Present specific constituent community location

    Kahnawà:ke's own Community and History sections identify it as a Mohawk/Kanien’kehá:ka community on the St. Lawrence just south of Montreal. The regional route indexes this specific Quebec community, not every Mohawk community or the entire historical Mohawk homeland. Kahnawà:ke, Akwesasne and other communities remain distinct; no treaty, citizenship or jurisdictional boundary is inferred.

    Community's About page inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Naskapi↗Present specific community and government location
    Connection & source
    Present specific community and government location

    The Naskapi Nation of Kawawachikamach's actual Land page describes its community northeast of Schefferville and gives its address at Kawawachikamach, Quebec. This is one present community/government route for the broader Naskapi access point. The source also describes historical movement into Labrador; this initial Quebec route is not an exclusive homeland boundary or a current land-claim assessment.

    Current Nation-published land account inspected 2026-10-21. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗
  • Wolastoqiyik↗Historical homeland connection
    Connection & source
    Historical homeland connection

    Opening history explicitly includes parts of New Brunswick and Québec in the Wolastoq watershed homeland. The organization separately describes its New Brunswick community mandate.

    Traditional homeland described by the Nation. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
